firestore_doc.Numismatic Report: This coin is a 2026 United States Semiquincentennial quarter commemorating the Mayflower Compact and early American heritage. The reverse (Image B) depicts the Mayflower ship under full sail, inscribed with 'UNITED STATES OF AMERICA', '25C', 'LIBERTY', and 'MAYFLOWER COMPACT'.
